title: Family Group Portrait, 1950s B&W Snapshot, 1954
back_text_transcription: "Family" Pat, Ma, Dad, Ag, Connie, Gert, Donna, + Tom (Frank added) 34th Anni. Sept 26, 1954 695
description: Black and white 1954 snapshot of an extended family gathering on a couch to celebrate a 34th anniversary. The subjects display classic 1950s hair, clothing, and posture against a scenic palm tree wallpaper backdrop.
